```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
Address_Master <- st_read("dataset/LIST_ADDRESS_POINTS_STATEWIDE/list_address_points_statewide.shp")
view(Address_Master)
property_listing_domain<- read_csv("dataset/tas_listings_with_price_and_geocode.csv")
view(property_listing_domain)

Address_Master$ST_NO_FROM <- as.character(Address_Master$ST_NO_FROM)
Address_Master$POSTCODE <- as.character(Address_Master$POSTCODE)
```


```{r}
# 1) Create / open a database file
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "my_data.duckdb", read_only = FALSE)
```


```{r}
dbExecute(con, "INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;")

# List of municipality object names already in R
muni_names <- c(
  "parcels_break_o_day",
  "parcels_brighton",
  "parcels_burnie",
  "parcels_central_coast",
  "parcels_central_highlands",
  "parcels_circular_head",
  "parcels_clarence",
  "parcels_derwent_valley",
  "parcels_devonport",
  "parcels_dorset",
  "parcels_flinders",
  "parcels_george_town",
  "parcels_glamorgan_spring_bay",
  "parcels_glenorchy",
  "parcels_hobart",
  "parcels_huon_valley",
  "parcels_kentish",
  "parcels_kingborough",
  "parcels_king_island",
  "parcels_latrobe",
  "parcels_launceston",
  "parcels_meander_valley",
  "parcels_northern_midlands",
  "parcels_sorell",
  "parcels_southern_midlands",
  "parcels_tasman",
  "parcels_waratah_wynyard",
  "parcels_west_coast",
  "parcels_west_tamar"
)

# Loop through each object, convert + write to DuckDB
for (muni in muni_names) {
  message("Processing: ", muni)
  
  # Get the sf object from environment
  sf_obj <- get(muni, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  # Convert to plain data frame with WKB geometry
  df <- sf_obj |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    as.data.frame()
  df$geometry <- st_as_binary(sf_obj$geometry)
  
  # Write to DuckDB with same name as in R
  dbWriteTable(con, muni, df, overwrite = TRUE)
}

```


```{sql, connection=con}
desc parcels_west_tamar;
desc parcels_glenorchy;

select PID,POT_PID,ST_AsText(ST_GeomFromWKB(geometry))   AS parcel_geometry from parcels_king_island where PID='9179130';
```




```{r}

# Build SQL string with UNION ALL
sql_parts <- lapply(muni_names, function(tbl) {
  muni_name <- toupper(gsub("^parcels_", "", tbl))   # e.g. "parcels_hobart" -> "HOBART"
  
  paste0(
    "SELECT PID, * EXCLUDE(PID), '", muni_name, "' AS MUNICIPALITY ",
    "FROM ", tbl, " ",
    "WHERE PID <> 0"
  )
})

master_sql <- paste(sql_parts, collapse = "\nUNION ALL\n")

# Wrap into CREATE TABLE
create_master_sql <- paste0(
  "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE parcels_master AS\n",
  master_sql,
  ";"
)

# Run in DuckDB
dbExecute(con, create_master_sql)
```


```{r}
# `{sql, connection=con}Explicitly coerce to data.frame after dropping geometry
address_master_tbl <- Address_Master |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  as.data.frame()

# Then add a WKB geometry column from the original sf object
address_master_tbl$geometry <- st_as_binary(Address_Master$geometry)


dbWriteTable(con, "address_master",address_master_tbl, overwrite = TRUE)

dbWriteTable(con, "property_listing_domain", property_listing_domain, overwrite = TRUE)

# (optional) useful indexes
dbExecute(con, "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_parcels_pid ON parcels_master(PID)")
dbExecute(con, "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_parcels_muncipality ON parcels_master(MUNICIPALITY)")
dbExecute(con, "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_addr_pid    ON address_master(PID)")
dbExecute(con, "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_listing_pid ON property_listing_domain(full_address)")
```

```{sql, connection=con}
drop view if exists PARCEL_ADDRESS_MASTER;
```

 -  we eliminate P.PID=0 because it is either a water body or any kind of road. 
```{sql, connection=con}
CREATE VIEW PARCEL_ADDRESS_MASTER AS select distinct(P.PID
),P.MUNICIPALITY, concat(
    cast(A.ST_NO_FROM as varchar), ' ', A.STREET, ' ', A.ST_TYPE, ' ', A.LOCALITY, ' TAS ', A.POSTCODE, ' Australia'
) as FULL_ADDRESS,P.geometry as parcel_geometry,P.POT_PID, A.geometry as address_geometry
from parcels_master P inner join address_master A on P.PID = A.PID where P.PID !='0' group by P.PID,P.MUNICIPALITY, FULL_ADDRESS,P.geometry,P.POT_PID, A.geometry;
```


```{sql, connection=con}

select count(*) from PARCEL_ADDRESS_MASTER;
select count(distinct(PID)) from PARCEL_ADDRESS_MASTER;

select distinct(PID), count(*) from PARCEL_ADDRESS_MASTER group by PID having count(*)>1 limit 5;
```


```{sql, connection=con}

SELECT *
FROM property_listing_domain d
JOIN PARCEL_ADDRESS_WEST_TAMAR p
  ON upper(trim(d.full_address)) = upper(trim(p.full_address));
```

```{sql, connection=con}
select d.full_address, p.PID from property_listing_domain d inner join PARCEL_ADDRESS_WEST_TAMAR p on d.full_address = p.full_address limit 5;
```

```{sql, connection=con}
SELECT 
    p.full_address AS parcel_address,
    d.full_address AS listing_address,
    length(p.full_address) AS len_p,
    length(d.full_address) AS len_d
FROM PARCEL_ADDRESS_WEST_TAMAR p
JOIN property_listing_domain d
  ON p.PID = '1481512'  -- restrict to the one you showed
LIMIT 5;

```

```{sql, connection=con}
SELECT p.PID ,d.full_address,d.latitude,d.longitude,ST_AsText(ST_GeomFromWKB(p.parcel_geometry))   AS parcel_wkt,
  ST_AsText(ST_GeomFromWKB(p.address_geometry))  AS address_wkt
FROM property_listing_domain d
JOIN PARCEL_ADDRESS_MASTER p
  ON upper(trim(replace(d.full_address, chr(160), ' '))) =
     upper(trim(replace(p.full_address, chr(160), ' ')));
```



```{sql, connection=con}

SELECT
  ST_AsText(ST_GeomFromWKB(p.parcel_geometry))   AS parcel_wkt,
  ST_AsText(ST_GeomFromWKB(p.address_geometry))  AS address_wkt
FROM PARCEL_ADDRESS_MASTER p
LIMIT 5;
```
